skill.summary: Virtual pet (Tamagotchi-style) game for chat platforms. Triggers on pet commands like "feed pet", "pet status", "play with pet", "name pet", "pet sleep", "new pet". Supports multi-user across Discord, WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. Each user gets their own pet that evolves based on care.

latestVersion.changelog:
OpenPet initial release.

- Introduces a Tamagotchi-style virtual pet game for chat platforms (Discord, WhatsApp, Telegram, etc).
- Each user gets their own evolving pet, tracked by platform and user ID.
- Supports interactive pet commands (feed, play, sleep, name, stats, help, new pet).
- Pet stats (hunger, happiness, energy, age) update via commands and a scheduled decay cron job.
- Multi-stage evolution system (egg → blob → cat → dragon) based on care and age.
- Immortal mode enabled by default: pets can’t die, but stats still matter.
- Automated alerts for critical pet needs, deaths (if enabled), and evolutions.
